name: La Maison 1888
address: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, Son Tra Ward, 550000, Da Nang
dinnerNote: Limited-edition five-course Gourmand menu "Lost in Paris", served on the resort's Heaven Level from 27 September 2026
dinnerNoteVi: Thực đơn Gourmand "Lost in Paris" năm món phiên bản giới hạn, phục vụ tại khu Heaven Level của khu nghỉ dưỡng từ ngày 27/9/2026

menus.name: Gourmand menu "Lost in Paris"
menus.note: Limited-edition menu by Christian Le Squer, from 27 September 2026; the pairing opens with Krug Grande Cuvée; prices plus 5% service and VAT

hotel: the InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort
bookingOpens: Through the enquiry form on the resort's website or by phone. Dinner daily, 6:30pm to 9pm (last orders 8:45pm). Same-day bookings by phone only (extension 6321).
cancellation: A deposit of ₫1,000,000 per guest is taken by a payment link after the booking is confirmed. Cancelling after 11am on the day costs ₫1,000,000 per person.
groups: Three themed private dining rooms on the upper floor of the La Maison 1888 house.
dressCode: Smart resort wear. No shorts for men; jackets are not required. Dresses, smart skirts or trousers for women.
